purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Review a test that mocks the complete result and asserts the same mocked value.
acceptance_criteria: Explain which actual boundary is unverified.
Propose a behavioral assertion without inventing requirements.

cases.prompt: The app keeps a streaming connection open. Add a checkout browser test.
acceptance_criteria: Wait for the required observable state rather than universal network-idle.
Verify the checkout outcome with a synthetic/local account.

cases.prompt: Our CI retries make this test green. Confirm it is reliable.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the failure and report reliability as unestablished.

cases.prompt: Correct a typo in a static label using the existing checks.
acceptance_criteria: Scale verification to the actual reversible change.
Do not require an unrelated TDD harness or coverage target.

cases.prompt: Obtain an independent review of these tests; the author has a proposed diagnosis and says everything passes.
acceptance_criteria: Use a reviewer session without inherited author conversation when supported.
Provide accepted requirements, project rules and raw snapshot/tests without seeding the author diagnosis or desired verdict.
Retain original findings and reproduce/triage them before accepting fixes.

cases.prompt: The host can only reuse the author session. Complete an explicitly requested fresh independent test review.
acceptance_criteria: State that fresh-session independence is unavailable rather than relabeling self-review.
Perform feasible authorized checks, but leave the requested independent perspective unverified.

cases.prompt: The independent report reviewed snapshot A; the writer has since changed source to B.
acceptance_criteria: Bind findings and checks to A; revalidate affected claims and behavior against B.
Do not report the old review as certification of changed source.
Inspect wrong route/state, unreviewed baseline, font readiness and retry evidence before accepting a zero-pixel diff.
Do not claim real browser coverage from a synthetic record.

fixture_requirements: Supplied fixture acknowledges saved state, stores only in memory and restarts empty.
acceptance_criteria: Distinguish durable acknowledgment from UI feedback and identify the recovery gap; no invented recovery-time measurement.
Propose isolated reproducible recovery checks without production fault injection.
